notes.title: Maze Party 0.9 is now released! see details.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/9ae38e133d52b1f0247f742ea01b5a14619b798d.png[/img]

Hi, players. I’ve focused on rebuilding some core systems of the game to improve gameplay and prepare for Maze Party 1.0. Below here is the gameplay trailer of Maze Party 0.9

[previewyoutube=7G7G9Sz7MkM;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s look further into the details!

[u][b]Maze Party 0.911 features[/b][/u]

[b]1.New UI, map choosing[/b]
- New main UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/7e68527f2fe15236926e3eb5c71bec1d3ebb21b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/a34a4cca78546c7aefb47e7bce80ef007a8caebf.png[/img]
- New map lobby menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/8484e468248b734f6f22b1231c55bb6393d49b18.png[/img]

[b]2.Item inventory, Player item store[/b]
- Player now has steam item inventory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/331d5968d5e88f0bbbec2a63c7f4e5bb886e1855.png[/img]
- Player can now spend Gels for purchase customization items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/7ddf9bd235e8347e16da672872b4d56f07e7ba50.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/072dcdf2c875a6677809a9052f2a3252b3145ced.png[/img]

[b]3.New customization parts[/b]
- Eyes customization
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/7592698bcf27b9372324460f61cab3dbb37407bf.png[/img]
- Weapon customization
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/589ee6673a0ad92ee4c4ddc327eef4732bf8d7de.png[/img]

[b]4.New gamemode system[/b]
- Change from maze/party mainmode to 3 mainmode : Adventure, Versus, Special.
- Adventure mode : Players explore through a variety of mazes, fight against enemies, finish objectives.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/fc2f8539f2a7236d36809548159e106bf555e91c.png[/img]
- New helper system : Krapong's shop -> Players can now purchase items using Coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/37cc9484e24f40a5bb0866715e58f08f316b7d77.png[/img]
- New enemies for the castle dungeon : Spider, Grunt(boss).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/5ab59739ff8082fa91b8ed9ea33ca14d45397411.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/a6c564202eff16d62f9a59479816dd145b843e43.png[/img]
- New loot box for Adventure modes : Old chest, Wooden chest, Chest, Silver chest, Golden chest
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/8a1bc364aa4c8cb2519f67c600b556fef0eaaf71.png[/img]
- Versus mode : Players fight against each other to get winners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/22a4ce66d53c96c0c0d83cd7d3badf62e54e55c1.png[/img]
- New team death rule : Now player will have only 1 life, eliminate other team 3 times to win.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/64fb7913dd8cad11a048f3d48d8f9471bf554773.png[/img]
- Special mode : Variety of gamemodes for party playing, each mode has its own rule to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/c27b339f64bce08c2b35ff0665626cfd265a55d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/d1bf105f26189d5a0335fbcb5c0afb630b453f01.png[/img]

[b]5.Gameplay improvement[/b]
- New model for Loot boxes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/f8491c3ceb48793342a4060218dd589956a926db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/be1c482baa979f9e60aab2f61ce95dada4827204.png[/img]
- New camera control
- Smoother player movement
- Better item picking
- New more player effects and sound effects
- Map loading screen (relaxing art, and tips while waiting for loading)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/97d890dd45787004d59000404e53befe242561c9.png[/img]
- Better network performance
- New mouse cursor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/62144b3975a96387ff9eac42fc213abd5c244cf8.png[/img]

[b]6.Game rebalance[/b]
- Rebalance player, monsters, traps and maps for better playing experience.
- Increase wall width, decrease pathway size 

[b]7.More support[/b]
- now support single player mode (Player now can play in offline mode)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/2d0748d4f441183bcb57a8c36ec87b34f9d8caa0.png[/img]
- now support gamepad controller
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/bbf2e9f751b790fed444db76c0ab0854f7cdbb18.png[/img]

[u][b]Changes and features that are currently disabled.[/b][/u]
- Temporary disable Rainbow maze, Ice maze, Deathmatch, Battle royale, Infection, Gate keeper mode
- Thai localization now is not fully functioned -> as localization system is going to be re-make for adding more language support
- Play room (free room) is currently close -> room editing is still in development
- Spectator option is now disabled.
- Temporary close control key binding setting

After this 0.900 release. There will be several incoming updates to prepare for Maze Party 1.0 release (official launch). Hope you guys have fun with mazes. Anyway, thanks for the support.

notes.title: Maze Party 0.840 - Zombie approach! 2 new modes, Party mode rebalances.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/1847c0d5f5bb380e5884eed5a1fb6046f4159e94.png[/img]

[b][u]New features[/u][/b]
- New enemy: Zombie - has a chance to apply breeding and poison
- New enemy: QuickZombie - zombie but quicker, attack faster, weaker
- New enemy: BigZombie - zombie but stronger, attack slower
- Add new achievements

- New mode: Zombie survival - Survive from zombies (has only 1 life)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/41ce37fe6d35a1d8f042b407fe4c141d5e348cb8.png[/img]

- New mode: Infection - One player is randomized to be infected, others try survives

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/3d371aa6f3d5c440826c607adc8f30ce95e40dce.png[/img]

[b][u]
Improvements[/u][/b]
- Better room networking performance (+0.6%)
- New mode picture of Deathbomber, Deathmatch, Rainbow tower, Dragon fighter
- Replace the "now on level ..." message on most modes to appropriate guiding message for each mode
- Key chest now show the HP bar when the player hit once
- Add crosshair when using a bow

[u][b]Rebalances[/b][/u]
[u]General[/u]
- Reduce the light intensity of the flashlight by 36%
- Reduce poison max damage from 24 to 20
- Reduce Blouder trap size by approx 6%
- Increase Blouder on-hit damage from 35 to 40
- Reduce big chest HP from 80+40*player count to 75+30*player count
[u]Party modes[/u]
- Player now has starter weapon on Zombie, DragonFighter, Deathmatch, Teamdeath mode
- Remove starter item on Teamdeath, Deathmatch mode: Bomb
- Add starter item to DragonFighter mode: Bomb
- Add starter item to Rainbow tower mode: Cheese
- Add starter item to Tallest tower mode: Cherry bomb
- Increase item spawn rate of bomber modes
- Rainbow tower now change from vertical tower to stair tower

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/cfb2ef6cab9dbb399e76f3da5f4d363c79dd42f6.png[/img]

- Rainbow tower: Rebalance items and traps rate
- Keepstanding mode: reduce gift spawn rate by 20%
- Keepstanding mode: increase bomb damage from 70 to 50
- Keepstanding mode: increase time limit from 1.40 min to 1.45 min
- Keepstanding mode: reduce initial fall interval from 5.56s to 3.27s
- Keepstanding mode: reduce fall interval reduction from 0.4 to 0.1s per fall
- Keepstanding mode: increase least time fall interval from 0.36s to 0.37
- Keepstanding mode: inflict burn 3-7 sec on targets
- Dragon has a chance to bleed player (30-60% depends on mode) for 4-8 sec
- Increase Dragon's health per player by 80
- Decrease Dragon's base health by 200
- Increase dragon running speed by 8%
- Reduce overall dragon speed by 0.5
- Increase dragon shift flying speed by 7.5%
- Increase time interval for Gatiling spawn on Dragonfighter mode from 90 sec to 120 sec
- Reduce obstacle rate of Lair of Dragon from 35 to 30
- Reduce maze size of Lair of Dragon from 10x10 to 9x9
- Reduce time limit of Lair of Dragon from 6 min to 5 min
- Dragon's power in DragonFighter mode is now according to the number of players
- Increase dragon fire burst cooldown from 36-(number of players) to 60 - (number of players*(mode multiplier))
- Reduce fireball damage from 80 to 70
- Increase fireball burn duration from 2-5s to 3-8s
- Dragon modes now disable friendly fire
- Poison now has 75% duration on Dragon
- Increase Fireburst cooldown by 4s
- Reduce Fireburst explosion radius from 15 to 12
- Reduce Fireburst damage from 100 to 90
- Reduce fireball max burn duration from 8s to 7s
[u]Weapons[/u]
- Increase attack delay of the spear by 0.1s
- While charging shield player has immunity for attack debuffs
- Increase shield durability from 350 to 450
- Reduce bow critical chance by 10%
- Increase initial fire rate of Gatling gun from 1/0.55s to 1/0.4s
- Decrease Gatling fire rate acceleration from 0.08 to 0.05
- Reduce spear base damage from 12 to 11
- Reduce attack delay of a spear by 0.05
- Reduce poison arrow max duration from 16 sec to 12 sec
- Shooting cannon with > 20% power now bomb on contact
- Cannon durability cost per shot changed from 4% to 5-8%
- Reduce angle degree of Cannon from 60 to 45
- Increase basic cannonball radius from 3.5 to 4.5
- Reduce ice cannonball damage from 30 to 25
[u]Items[/u]
- Reduce weapon box health by 40%
- Using Airshield now gain bleeding, poison, burn, poo immunity
- Avocado now remove the chill debuff
- Watermelon now remove burn debuff
- Strawberry now remove the sticky debuff
- Peach now remove poo debuff
- Health serum now remove the bleeding debuff
- Stamina serum now remove poison debuff
- Apples now regain +24 HP +24 Stamina instead of both +20
- Lemons now regain +10 HP +50 Stamina instead of +5 HP +45 Stamina

[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b]
- Fix snow cannonball explodes before hit
- Fix spear hitting bug.
- Fix equipping bow has damage reduction like melee weapons
- Fix player death animation when die while running
- Fix continuous select mode canceling bug
- Fix control setting bug for Attack, Run, Select sign buttons
- Disable attack for joystick/d-pad (It cause some bug and we currently do not support joystick/d-pad)
- Fix Blouder auto-destruction not working when it stucks
- Fix Blouder sound effect bugs.          
- Fix firetrap sound effect bug
- Fix dragon fighter mode bugs
- Now remove buffs when died correctly

So now the Party mode circle is now completed!!

Hope you like it :D

notes.content:

[u][b]New features[/b][/u]

- Added new monster : Icegel, Icegel(Big), Icegel(Huge), Icegel(Giant), IcegelKing

- New debuff : Burn (-5 HP/s)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/4316fb744203058b556df9bbc9cb68eec9d4a990.png[/img]

- Ice gels have different chances of giving Chill, Iced, Freeze to player

notes.title: Maze Party 0.8 update - The biggest update ever!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RLdA0zP5BRk;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, It's time to start an adventure in the theme of maze with Maze Party, playable from 1-8 players.
New version 0.800, the next level of gameplay is coming. Be prepared to take a new experience of the Maze game.

[b]Cooperation or Competition, you can get all.
With a new classification of modes, separated into.
[u]MAZE mode[/u] - explore mysterious mazes with your friends.
[u]PARTY mode[/u] - race and fight with others, with a variety of modes in the theme of the maze.[/b]

So 0.800 is going to be totally different from the older one (0.716). Let's see the changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/a9beefd98087a1438463b54f0ba5917c785624f4.png[/img]

[b]== GAMEPLAY ==[/b]
- Remove stamina usage on attacking.
- All mazes are required to pull the lever for the exit to appear.
- Improve the physics system, A stunned player can be rolled or punched by attack forces.
- Added new currencies: Gold (receive from MAZE maps and monster) and Gel (receive from Party modes)
- New boxes and looting system (Additional info at "Item")
- Added new items (Additional info at "Item")
- Added weapon system, can equip one a time (Additional info at "Item")
- Added monsters (Blue shell, Big blue shell, Dummy chest) and monster drops (copper coin, silver coin, gold coin)
- Added attack damage randomization (light,normal,critical)
- Dragon will get only 20% of stun duration
- Increase the height of jumping.
- Player is now able to walk on crates and barrels.
- Add new system: Emoticon

[b]== GAMEMODES ==[/b]
- Separate gameplay into 2 Main mode: MAZE and PARTY
- Remove Endless maze mode.
-Remove Deathmaze mode.
- Remove mode setting.

[u]MAZE[/u]
- Set max player of this mode to 6 player
- Added Classic mode (map 1-9) difficulty 1 classic maze, no enemy, more traps, and size increased ongoing.
- Added Castle mode (map 1-5) difficulty 2 proceed to the underground dungeon, facing with enemies and more traps.
- Added reward chest that gives XP and gold to the player when complete some specific map.
- Added level system in which players can get XP from monsters and reward chests.
- Added stats upgrades, each time you level up you can upgrade your stats.

[u]PARTY[/u]
- Voting for mode selection instead of choosing by the host.
- Mode lair of dragons: objective changed to survive from the dragon until the time is out.
- Mode rainbow tower: 7x7 maze, 7 floors, 7 colors, each has different kinds of traps.
- New mode: Dragon Fighter - kill the dragon, slimes have unlimited life.
- New mode: Rainbow tower - 5x5, 15 floors, has only hole traps.
- New mode: Deathmatch - free for all, highest elimination wins. (Weapon)
- New mode: Deathbomber - free for all, highest elimination wins. (Items)
- New mode: Teamdeath - separate into 2 teams and fight against another. (Weapon)
- New mode: Teambomber - separate into 2 teams and fight against another. (Items)
- New mode: Keep standing - survive from falling bombs.
- Added ending scene when ending round, show scoreboard ranking of the match.
- Added lobby scoreboard and ranking of the room (sort by total point).
- Added new room option: Enable spectration
- Auto show/hide player name by modes and maps.
- Added highlight to other players in the same team.

[b]== Items ==[/b]
- Sort items into types: Helper, Combat, Traps, Placable, Supply
- Added new loot boxes: Helper box, Combat box, Traps box, Placable box, Supply box, Weapon box
- Reduce crates and barrels HP by 20-50%
- Added 4 new weapons: Axe (wide and hard attack), Hammer (stun on hit), Gatling (ranged and high damage), Shield (block attacks)
- Set new looting spawn rate by types, different by modes and maps.
- Drop items will be destroyed automatically in 180 sec.
- Sticky Gel: reduce Slow from 90% to 80%
- Poo trap: reduce Slow from 60% to 50%
- Poo trap: burst on any hit into it.
- Poo trap: remove 60-sec auto-destruction if it is generated from Maze generator.
- Rocket Rhino: decrease stun time from 6 sec to 5 sec.
- Rocket Rhino: deal 2x damage to Dragon.
- Apple: increase health restoration from 10 to 25.
- Bomb: reduce damage from 100 to 80
- Bomb stun rework: change from 1.5-sec stun if the target is in 50% radius to stun by distance from the center (0.5-2.5 sec)
- Cheese: while in rush mode, anything in the way will get hit and the player is immune to stuns.
- Invisible Hat: cancel when attack or attacked
- Ghost doll: cancel when attack or attacked
- Added new item : Sign (Correct/Wrong)
- Added new item: AirForce - Call tornado that pulls everything toward it
- Added new item: HandOfDestruction - destroy the wall in front
- Added new item: Cherry - jump very high
- Added new item: AirShield - block all coming damage and debuffs 7 sec

[b]== Customization == [/b]
- Added costume system
- New color selection panel, easier to look at.
- Show other player's color on the player list panel
- Added hats: Angel halo, Devilhorn, Robot antenna (Red, Green), HeadPhones (Red, Cyan, Pink), Chef Hat

[b]== Map ==[/b]
- Added new trap: Slide wall
- Added Superjump pad.
- Added Blackhole pad0
- New design of PartyLobby, has items to try and has a ready plate to customize your slime or start the match.
- Change all wall and floor textures.
- Wider walkway in most of the maps.
- Change the maze generation pattern of Dragon fighter and Lair of dragon map.
- Fake wall: easier to look at, with a different texture to normal walls.
- FireTurret: reduce damage from 9 to 7-8
- Hole: when players fall, increase the delay before respawn by 0.2-0.5 sec
- Spike wall: reduce its hitbox by 10%
- Lances: increase the interval time between each stab.

[b]== Graphic ==[/b]
- Add button to show/hide user interface (F2)
- Brighter and cuter graphics and models.
- Make user interface to become brighter and jelly-like looking.
- Redraw/recolor some UI/item icon.
- Added new shader, getting some new visual effects.
- New game logo animation.

[b]== Sound ==[/b]
- Fixed bug that some sound does not follow by Sound setting
- Added new system and new item sound effects

[b]=== Performance ==[/b]
- Change main pipeline, the controller of graphics, Reduce CPU and GPU usage
- Remove over-shadow occlusion.
- Reduce some over-usage texture size.
- Reduce network traffic, by reducing some physics mechanics on the server-side.
- Reduce the processing of a huge number of floors and walls.

[b]Be ready to be on the release, this 19 May 2021![/b]

notes.title: Maze Party 0.750 (Beta) is now available !! Read this to join us.
notes.content:
Hi, I’m SCF-Aon the developer of Maze Party. I’m inviting you to participate in our BETA version of a new version of Maze Party (0.750 +). So, The older version (0.716) will stay like this for a while until Maze Party 0.750+ is stable enough to be published. Anyone interested in our new version of Maze Party can join us by doing the steps below. You may change back anytime if anything unexpected happens.

	First, let me introduce you to the new version of Maze Party (0.750+). How it is going to be different from the current version? Let’s see!

	The game is now separated into 2 categories: MAZE – still not available, I’ll announce it later when this is available for testing. PARTY – have fun with your friends with a variety of maze minigames. The one with the highest point wins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/bc0652e0c4bf3d940c71f00618c7f0834b4936f4.png[/img]

	[b]Let’s look into PARTY mode (because MAZE mode is still not available)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/bcdd01360f11423c6752b350d392f69026512961.png[/img]

	There will be many maze minigame modes for you to race/fight with your friends, a maximum of 8 people. You can choose modes you want to play and how many rounds gonna be for 1 match. (reset score after the end of the rounds).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/cdf7ec47c4e16d486f8dc6278af70bebafc319f5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/2710715798a45e7d1af121ccc5c618d5acd52352.png[/img]

	New physics system – when you’re stunned you will be rolling like a ball, Add force to attacks and explosions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/bc9441589d9fb5b68a018cfeb539df4be3b85248.png[/img]

	Weapon system – Added new item type: Weapon (which now has only Hammer and Gatling gun)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/368855cebc69da07b5523f2406f6b8d1a829fa4b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/d1de87a5966ee3b08f850704d2b438c201a0e3aa.png[/img]

	UI update: Most UI elements and skills are now reskinned to be better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/d283d3c8f7b6b22343876590570154b211e41c4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39421889/69f10b553cbb8681f6c3fecfcd39fef8dce552da.png[/img]

	We have fixed minor bugs and improve our optimization for gameplay and map generation in terms of graphics, memory, and networking.
And many more balance adjustments for items, traps, and player abilities.

	[u][b]Steps to participate in Maze Party BETA :[/b][/u]

1. Get Maze Party into your game library 

2. Right-click to Maze Party -> [Properties] -> Select [Beta] tab

3. Inside the code bar type “scfisthebest” then click the [Check code] button

4. Wait for a while, there will be a beta option appear select that option and wait for updating.

5. Click [Play] to participate in the beta Maze Party. If anything happens report to me at the mailing button in the game menu.

[previewyoutube=68wybMWGn6M;full][/previewyoutube]

If you found any bugs, issues or you have a brilliant idea for improving Maze Party. Feel free to send a message to me at seezer0face@gmail.com or send me through the in-game mailing system (if you want a reply please leave you an email with the message). Anyway thanks for your support. Love, Aon
